newsitem.title: UK: National Power dips as UBS downgrades.
newsitem.headline: National Power dips as UBS downgrades.

text.p: Shares in National Power Plc eased on Wednesday against the overall trend of the UK market as analysts at UBS cut the stock to "hold" from "buy," dealers said.

National Power shares were down 1-1/2p at 513-1/2 by 1058 GMT in volume of just under one million shares. By contrast, rival power generator PowerGen Plc, where UBS repeated a "buy" rating, was up three pence at 700.
Analyst Ian Taylor at UBS said National Power shares had reached his valuation target. He raised his target for PowerGen to 800p, based on a valuation of its UK generation business.
